summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filing by KKR FS Income Trust Select, a business development company, announcing a declaration of a monthly dividend of $0.175 per common share, payable on or about October 28, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 30, 2026. The dividend may be taken in cash or reinvested in shares under the distribution reinvestment plan. This is an ordinary dividend announcement, not a special situation. It does not involve any M&A, restructuring, capital return beyond customary distributions, or any other special-situation transaction. Accordingly, this filing is classified as None.
